name: miku-backlog-archive
description: Create a local, static archive of one Backlog project.

scripts.check: node --check src/cli.mjs && node --check src/archive/atomic-write.mjs && node --check src/archive/collector.mjs && node --check src/archive/format.mjs && node --check src/archive/normalize.mjs && node --check src/archive/report.mjs && node --check src/archive/render.mjs && node --check src/archive/session.mjs && node --check src/backlog/runtime.mjs
scripts.test: node --test test/archive-session.test.mjs test/cli.test.mjs test/collector.test.mjs test/render.test.mjs test/report.test.mjs test/runtime.test.mjs
